understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a corresponding goal tile marked '+'. A level is won only when all goal tiles are occupied simultaneously.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces were moved by clicking target positions. Movement was constrained by walls and obstacles; blocked clicks caused no movement but still consumed a step. Selecting and moving a piece could reposition it between reachable tiles, while attempts to move through blocked areas had no effect. The limited step count made efficient path planning necessary.
